name: Sola Security
description: Sola AI Assistant for Slack lets you explore your security data, surface critical issues, review your project details, and get answers about your environment, all without leaving Slack. It is powered by Sola's security intelligence platform.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sola Security to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sola Security to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.sola.security/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sola Security MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sola Security provides these MCP tools: execute_sql, explore_data, get_app_details, get_app_queries_tool, get_data_exploration_status, get_risk_cluster_detail, get_vendor_schemas, get_vendor_tables, list_apps, and list_risk_clusters_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sola Security?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sola Security in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.

_published_faq.name: Does Sola Security MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sola Security requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sola Security is developed by Sola Security. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
